understand.placeHint: Highlight only this place and move playback to its start.
explore.leaveHint: Go back to what you had before this experiment.
compare.originalHint: Hear the original phrase and show it in the score. The variation stays to come back to.
compare.variationHint: Hear the variation and show it in the score with the variation in place.
compare.alternateHint: Loops the original phrase, then the variation, then again.
compare.alternateVersionHint: Loops the phrase as in the score, then as in {0}, then again.
compare.notesHint: Hear the phrase as in the score.
understand.nothingYet: Nothing to say about this selection yet: music-core needs a few notes to read. Pick a phrase or a sentence above.
insights.claimHint: Ring its places on the score; tap again to clear them.
circle.title: Circle of fifths
circle.showHint: Rings these notes on the score
dna.formEmpty: The sections of the whole piece are not analysed yet.
dna.ideasEmpty: Select a passage on the score and open Piece DNA again: it shows every place where the passage returns.
dna.ideasNone: No opening of a phrase is heard again elsewhere. Select a passage on the score and open Piece DNA again to see where it returns.
dna.harmonyEmpty: A single line: there are no chords to read.
dna.dynamicsEmpty: Every note is as loud: the file gives no dynamics.
dna.bookmarksAdded.one: {0} Structure bookmark added (one for each section of the form).
dna.bookmarksAdded.many: {0} Structure bookmarks added (one for each section of the form).
dna.bookmarksAlready: None added: every section of the form already has one.
dna.why.form: One letter is the same material; ′ means it came back changed.
dna.why.key: The key each part sounds in.
dna.why.harmony: The chord of each bar, its step in the key and what it does: T rest, S motion, D tension.
dna.why.newMaterial: Dark: heard for the first time. Light: heard before.
dna.why.register: From the lowest to the highest note of each bar.
dna.why.dynamics: How loud each bar is played.
dna.keyHint: Show the circle of fifths for this part
